name: Aeron JJN Scalper EA
summary: Aeron JJN Scalper EA is a scalping expert advisor that uses the JJN indicator (likely a composite momentum/trend indicator) to generate rapid buy and sell signals on lower timeframes. It aims to capture small price movements with tight take-profit targets and is designed for high-frequency, short-duration trades typical of scalping strategies.
summary_zh: Aeron JJN Scalper EA是一款剥头皮专家顾问，使用JJN指标（可能是复合动量/趋势指标）在较低时间周期上生成快速买卖信号。它旨在通过紧密的止盈目标捕捉小幅价格波动，适合剥头皮策略典型的高频、短时交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于JJN指标信号进行剥头皮交易，JJN指标可能结合了动量和趋势判断来生成买卖信号。入场条件为JJN指标发出买入或卖出信号时开仓，通常在M1或M5等短周期上操作以捕捉微小的价格波动。出场条件依赖预设的固定止盈和止损值，止盈目标较小符合剥头皮策略特征。仓位管理方面，EA可能提供手数参数供用户设定，但缺乏动态仓位调整机制。资金管理较为简单，没有看到基于账户余额或风险比例的自适应手数计算，存在过度交易的风险。整体策略逻辑相对直接，依赖指标信号的准确性和低点差环境来盈利。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on JJN indicator signals for scalping trades, where the JJN indicator likely combines momentum and trend assessment to generate buy and sell signals. Entry conditions trigger when the JJN indicator issues a buy or sell signal, typically operating on short timeframes like M1 or M5 to capture small price movements. Exit conditions rely on preset fixed take-profit and stop-loss values, with small take-profit targets characteristic of scalping strategies. Position sizing likely offers a lot size parameter for user configuration but lacks dynamic position adjustment mechanisms. Money management is relatively simple, with no adaptive lot calculation based on account balance or risk ratio, posing a risk of over-trading. The overall strategy logic is straightforward, relying on indicator signal accuracy and low-spread environments to be profitable.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: Manage positions with specific magic number only; 0 manages all

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调试
剥头皮策略在小波动市场中可以快速积累小额利润
使用固定止盈止损，风险边界明确可控
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and debug
Scalping strategy can quickly accumulate small profits in low-volatility markets
Uses fixed take-profit and stop-loss, providing clearly defined risk boundaries
cons: 缺乏点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能频繁止损
没有动态仓位管理，无法根据账户风险自适应调整手数
剥头皮策略对经纪商执行质量高度依赖，回测结果可能与实盘差异大
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
cons_en: Lacks spread filter, which may cause frequent stop-loss triggers in high-spread environments
No dynamic position sizing, unable to adaptively adjust lot size based on account risk
Scalping strategy is highly dependent on broker execution quality, backtest results may differ significantly from live trading
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening repeated positions on the same bar
improvements: 增加点差过滤器，当点差超过阈值时暂停交易以避免不必要的止损
实现基于账户余额和风险比例的动态仓位计算
添加新K线检查以防止同一K线上重复开仓
improvements_en: Add a spread filter to pause trading when spread exceeds a threshold, avoiding unnecessary stop-losses
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account balance and risk ratio
Add new bar check to prevent repeated position opening on the same bar

risk_points: 剥头皮策略在高点差环境下可能持续亏损
缺乏动态仓位管理可能导致大额亏损时风险暴露过高
对经纪商执行速度和滑点高度敏感
risk_points_en: Scalping strategy may incur continuous losses in high-spread environments
Lack of dynamic position sizing may lead to excessive risk exposure during large losses
Highly sensitive to broker execution speed and slippage
